srList.sentence: Exclusion criteria were following: 1) previous diagnosis of POAG; 2) age < 30 years old; 3) severe opacity of refractive media; 4) narrow or closed-angle; 5) the previous history of intraocular surgery; 6) any of the factors (such as uveitis) causing secondary glaucoma; 7) anomalous discs, including tilted discs; 8) corneal diseases influencing the measurement of intraocular pressure (IOP).
